changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ReportLayout_backup') BEGIN DROP TABLE [dbo].[ReportLayout_backup] END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ReportLayout_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ReportLayout_backup]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](1000) NULL, [Template] [nvarchar](1000) NOT NULL, [NumberOfContentAreas] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ReportLayout] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
